assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring via CPT 93229 is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may contribute to hemodynamic instability or embolic risk.
The diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I47.1 support the medical necessity of this service.
The authorization is missing and the claim was denied under CO-197.
Advance approval was warranted prior to services rendered.
